headline.case: upper for stat words (WATER, 2400L), sentence-case for phrase captions (But Remember)
headline.size_rel: huge for single stat numbers (0.5x screen width), medium for phrase captions (2 lines max)

caption.size_rel: small pill-label size, ~0.05 of frame height

layout.host_pos: centered full-bleed frame in early b-roll (island/field), later tight chest-up talking-head inside a red-arched doorway vignette
layout.safe_zones: bottom ~15% reserved for platform-UI end card only at very end; captions sit mid-lower third, stat numbers sit center or upper-third
layout.caption_pos: short colored pill/badge captions bottom-left or center under host chin; big stat text centered mid-frame over b-roll/graphic

transitions: match-cut host walk to next b-roll
graphic build-up (bars/glasses filling one by one)

themeable: accent color (currently AI-blue, swappable per topic)
stat number graphic style (glass/bottle fill, bar chart, map heat)
